onValueChange.notes: Fires in addition to native onChange; reason is always 'none'.

className/style/render.notes: State = FieldControlState { disabled, touched, dirty, valid, filled, focused }.

renderProp.elementForm: render={<input />} or a custom component that forwards ref and spreads props

controlled.note: Native onChange still works and is merged (mergeProps runs handlers right-to-left).

formIntegration.note: A real <input>, so it is the form control itself: name/id/value submit natively and participate in constraint validation. Automatically reads Field.Root context (docs state Input is the canonical Field.Control replacement).

keyboard.focus: Native; focus state surfaces as data-focused inside Field.Root.

notableDifferences: React Aria's Input is a styled wrapper around the native input with isDisabled/isReadOnly/isInvalid props; Base UI's Input is a thin native <input> that inherits disabled/required/readOnly from Field.Root context (and has no is- props).
Controlled usage is value + onValueChange (not React Aria's value + onChange).
Validation state is not passed in — it is observed from the DOM constraint-validation API and mirrored as data-valid/data-invalid.
